title: Earth and Space: Four Ways to Play
description: A four-question science and geography break: pick an answer, inspect a diagram, arrange planets, and match water-cycle processes. One point per complete correct question.

questions.prompt: Which ocean basin is the largest on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific is the largest ocean basin. NOAA ranks the Atlantic second and the Indian third.

questions.prompt: Put these four planets in order from nearest to farthest from the Sun.
questions.explanation: The four inner planets, moving outward from the Sun, are Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars.

questions.prompt: Match each water-cycle process to its description.

right.label: Water falls from clouds as rain or snow
Water vapor changes into liquid water
Liquid water changes into water vapor

questions.explanation: Evaporation changes liquid water into vapor; condensation turns vapor into liquid. Rain and snow falling from clouds are examples of precipitation.
